verdict.rationale: A data-pipeline product with a managed hosting option could reasonably publish an AI-training opt-out or no-training policy, so this axis applies. The evidence pack has no such policy, setting, or commitment. Self-hosting ('You host and manage everything on your own servers') is an adjacent deployment choice, not a documented control preventing AI training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
